ky-county-officers.summary: Your County card names the county and nobody who runs it — no judge-executive, no sheriff, no clerk, no attorney.
ky-county-officers.why: The state does publish a list of every county's elected officials, and this app has not built it into a card yet.
ky-county-officers.wanted: Nothing from a reader — this one is ours to build.

ky-fiscal-court.summary: The districts your county's magistrates or commissioners are elected from are not on the map, and no card names them.
ky-fiscal-court.why: Most Kentucky counties do not publish their district boundaries as map data, and the one statewide list of county officials does not say which district each person holds.
ky-fiscal-court.wanted: A magisterial or commissioner district boundary file for a county that does not publish one, or any source pairing a Kentucky county board member with the district they hold.

ky-judges.summary: Louisville's circuit and district court cards name no judge. Every other court card in Kentucky now names the judges elected from it.
ky-judges.why: The Court of Justice lists the judges of every other circuit and district and lists none for Jefferson County. We asked about it on 1 October 2026 and are waiting, so those two cards name nobody rather than guessing.
ky-judges.wanted: Anywhere the Court of Justice publishes the judges of Jefferson County's 30th judicial circuit and 30th judicial district with their divisions, as it already does for every other circuit and district in the state.

ky-legislature-roster.summary: Your Kentucky Senate and House cards name the district you are in and nobody who holds it.
ky-legislature-roster.why: The General Assembly publishes both rosters and this app has not built them yet. The cards link each chamber's own member directory instead of naming a member it has not verified.
ky-legislature-roster.wanted: Nothing from a reader — this one is ours to build.

ky-municipal-officeholders.summary: Your City card names the city and nobody who governs it — no mayor, no council member.
ky-municipal-officeholders.why: The state's municipal directory answers one city at a time rather than publishing a list, and this app has not built a roster from it. The card links that directory instead of naming anyone.
ky-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A machine-readable list of Kentucky's city mayors and council members, from the state or from a city that publishes its own.

ky-school-board-members.summary: Your school district cards name the district and nobody on its board.
ky-school-board-members.why: Kentucky elects county school boards by division and independent boards at large, and this app has built neither roster. The cards link the state's own district directory instead of naming anyone.
ky-school-board-members.wanted: Any source naming a Kentucky school board member against the division they were elected from, or a county's own division boundaries as map data.
